notes: Data only: URL patterns, CSS selectors, text labels and JSON paths. You must sign in to use Instagram in the app; "Log in with Facebook" needs Facebook's login hosts in allowedHosts. Target hrefs, roles and structure, never generated class names. Notes say where a signal comes from; 'unverified' marks rules not yet checked against a logged-in session (see docs/RULES.md). Rules that hide whole feed posts use collapse, because the feed breaks when a post is removed (see docs/RULES.md).

signIn.note: Signed out, everything but the account pages (logging in, signing up, resetting a password, two-factor codes) and security checks goes to the login page, instead of the public pages, which promote opening the app.

features.title: Hide Reels
features.description: Removes the Reels tab and blocks the endless Reels feed. A reel someone sends you opens on its own.

routes.note: A link into the Reels feed at one reel (/reels/<code>/) opens that reel's own page instead. unverified

hide.note: The Reels tab and any link into the Reels feed.
The tab's slot in the tab bar, which spaces its tabs evenly, so the bar has no gap where Reels was. Matches the divs around the Reels link that hold no other link (checked signed in).

features.title: Search instead of Explore
features.description: The Explore tab opens Search. Blocks the Explore grid and the hashtag, location and suggested-people feeds.

routes.note: Assumes mobile web serves the search page at /explore/search/. unverified

hide.note: Post tiles under the search box, if the search page shows any. Keyword results (/explore/search/keyword/) are not affected. unverified

features.title: Following feed
features.description: Home shows posts from accounts you follow, newest first, instead of the algorithmic feed.

routes.note: Home showing any feed but Following and Favorites: with no feed chosen, including /?deoia=1, where Instagram lands after logging in, and with another one, such as /?variant=home, which is the algorithmic feed (checked signed in).

features.title: Hide suggestions
features.description: Hides suggested posts and "Suggested for you" account boxes, and any post in your home feed from an account you don't follow.

hideByText.note: The label on suggested posts. unverified
In the home feed, a post with a Follow button is from an account you don't follow: a suggestion or an ad. Home feed only, so posts people send you still show. unverified

prune.note: "Suggested for you" account boxes, removed from the feed data before they render. Slot names seen in the feed data, like the rules below; none was filled in 40 Following-feed items. unverified
Suggested posts from Explore, such as those after "You're all caught up". unverified
Promoted units in the feed, such as suggested reels. unverified
Story units in the feed, such as suggested stories. unverified

hide.note: The "Suggested for you" accounts box, whose header links to /explore/people/. Signal from AdGuard's annoyances filter.
Any other link to the suggested-people page.

features.title: Hide ads
features.description: Hides sponsored posts, story ads, and posts marked as a paid partnership.

hideByText.note: The label under the account name on ads ("Ad", seen signed in, or "Sponsored") and paid partnerships ("Paid partnership with ...").

hide.note: Ad posts link to Facebook's ad information page, whatever the language. Signal from the AdGuard Base filter.
Ad buttons such as Learn more link out through l.instagram.com, and ordinary posts can't link out. unverified

prune.note: Story ads, removed from the API response before they render. Path from uBlock Origin's filters.

Feed items are slots (media, ad, suggested_users, ...) with the unused ones null; this drops the items that carry an ad. Slot names seen in the feed data; no ad was filled in 40 Following-feed items. unverified
Instagram's ads for advertising on Instagram. unverified

features.title: Tab bar in messages
features.description: Keeps the tab bar at the bottom of your inbox, so your feed is a tap away.

keep.note: Instagram's mobile site removes its tab bar, a fixed box of links, when you open messages (checked). Only the inbox: a conversation has the message box at the bottom.

style.note: Room for the kept tab bar under your conversations, which otherwise scroll on behind it, so it covered the last one. The list is the last part of this box, and shrinks to make room (checked signed in).

features.title: Hide "Open in app" prompts
features.description: Hides links that push you to install or open the Instagram app.

hide.note: The app never opens intent: or instagram: links whatever this setting is; this only hides them.

hideByText.note: The "Use the app" bar above the tab bar on a post's page, a button with no link to hide it by, with its close button (checked signed in).
